item_name: Rothco USMC With Eagle, Globe & Anchor Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Show your pride with the Rothco USMC Cap featuring the iconic Eagle, Globe & Anchor insignia. Made from durable 100% brushed cotton twill, this military cap is built to last while providing a comfortable fit. The U.S.M.C. Globe & Anchor emblem is beautifully embroidered on the front panel, and the military hat also features USMC lettering for added detail. An adjustable hook & loop closure in the back ensures a perfect fit for most head sizes, while the internal padded sweatband offers extra comfort for extended wear.
